item.title: Emacs for NvChads
item.description: Emacs is not just a text editor. Emacs is an OS inside of an OS. You can do everything with it once you start digging below the surface. Emacs doesn't stop you from anything. Become the god of the editor.

item.title: Extreme Privacy, or stay like everyone else?
item.description: One should have a way to express oneself, even if it is wrong or incorrect to someone else. Every opinion SHOULD have a place to exist. Only in such a manner can we, as a society, continue to develop. No politician should dictate people's life, and no person should be arrested, or blacklisted for saying something that those in power do not understand or do not like.

item.title: AI based learning is a joke
item.description: Initially I was looking for some resources for mastering x86 ASM and this is when the motivation to write this post was born. After asking a bunch of people I had nothing but a "just use AI to learn x" recommendation. Don't consider it personal. Learning is fun. Always has been and always will be. However, in the modern era of Artificial Inteligence (LLMs for now) people don't actually learn anymore. They prompt and immediately get the answer. There is no learning here, just some wording, and copy-pasting the answer.
